scope: public packaging and synthetic software checks only
credential_scan_boundary: Selected common key and credential-URL patterns; not a guarantee against every possible secret. Private Git history is not included.

initial_attempt.explanation: One planning-contract test requires excluded CT model; it remains an archive-dependent historical test, not in public suite. A temp-file write was denied by sandbox; repeated synthetic suite with workspace-local temporary directory passed.

historical_formatting.git_diff_check: reports inherited trailing whitespace/blank EOF only; source formatting preserved

privacy_review.scope: All tracked snapshot paths and UTF-8 content; known personal identifiers, institutional paths and interpersonal references
privacy_review.history: Owner-authorized replacement of public main history with a privacy-reviewed root snapshot. Private local history backup retained. Remote caches and third-party copies are outside this operation.
privacy_review.boundary: Scholarly citations, third-party attribution and GitHub account handle retained. Remote caches and third-party copies are outside this check.
